reason: I can cook kaphrao and pork omelet with my eyes closed, and when I want to try curry or tom yum I just watch a free clip before bed. What stops me cooking is time, not recipes, and a plate outside is only 50-60 baht.
objection: It's another monthly subscription. 99 baht every month is two plates of food for recipes I can already get free on my phone, and I'd have to remember to cancel after the free month.
would_change_my_mind: No monthly fee: let me pay once, under 100 baht, and keep the dishes.
